audit: H1b rule-anchored C2 level and mask diagnostic; feature-only, not target evaluation

decision.H1b_verdict: inconclusive for organizer-reference levels/masks; internal proxy rules are already clipped, and the only additional source/zero-count signals do not identify the removed reference counts or undefined masks
reason_S2_not_built: TIGER S1100/S1200 tract presence is absent, so the organizer transport-defined mask and any hidden-reference undefined mass cannot be identified.

Microsoft-sourced Overture membership is measurable, but it does not prove exact overlap, completeness, vintage, or count equality with the removed Microsoft US Building Footprints reference; the source-share correction is only a sensitivity.
CBP and USGS counts are absent/forbidden. Overture all-place counts and exact-category zeros cannot prove Overture>=CBP or USGS-zero; facility stress tests therefore cannot be promoted to S2.

The C2 estimator already clips its own feature-derived expected-count ratios at zero when Overture counts meet/exceed those internal proxies. Those proxies are assumptions, not validated reference counts. No rule correction has an admissible identified effect on hidden-target levels.
The one-candidate cap is already occupied by S; an unsupported second shrink artifact would violate the row's candidate budget without providing evidence of a target-level improvement.
decision.recommendation: retain S_crossmethod_reliability_shrink_v1 as the sole shrink candidate; do not build or register S2

limitations: Internal expected counts are deterministic recipe priors derived from provided population, land, urbanity, and Overture counts; they are not organizer reference counts or independent validation.
Microsoft source share is Overture provenance, not proof that each record matches a reference footprint, and not an observation of Microsoft-reference coverage.
The raw-zero facility scenarios assume Overture count zero implies USGS count zero; actual reference-definedness cannot be measured under the competition restriction.
Without labels or permitted reference counts, no corrected component level is a hidden-target accuracy claim.

measure_before.source_H1_C2_means_note: All means here are recomputed from the frozen C2 feature-only component CSV over the existing recipe's defined flags; no organizer reference values are available.

reproduction.command: uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/audit_shrink_h1b_rule_levels.py --workspace $COMPETITION_WORKSPACE --out reports/shrink-h1b-rule-level-audit.json
reproduction.determinism: No random operations; report is sorted-key JSON with input hashes and no generation timestamp.

rule_level_measurements.interpretation: Numeric mass values are sums of frozen C2/recipe gap predictions or explicitly labeled proxy counterfactuals. Null actual-reference mass means it is not identifiable from permitted provided data, not zero.
